name: Spirit Rock
summary: Above the Valley of Trials in Durotar, Horde initiates climb Spirit Rock to commune with the elements. The Hidden Path winds up to the sacred crag.

sections.title: A Sanctuary of the Elements
sections.body: Spirit Rock looks down on the red canyon where young Horde warriors and scouts train. From the canyon floor, the Hidden Path winds up the rocky ridgeline to a quiet altar. There, aspiring shaman drink sapta, a traditional brew that opens their senses beyond the physical world. They listen for the earth's rumblings and whispers.

faq.q: What is Spirit Rock used for?
faq.answer: Horde shaman initiates go to Spirit Rock to commune with the spirits of the earth. Novices drink Earth Sapta there to gain the spiritual vision needed to reach them.

faq.q: How do you reach Spirit Rock?
aliases: how to get to spirit rock
faq.answer: Climb the Hidden Path from the Valley of Trials in southwestern Durotar. The narrow trail winds from the canyon floor into the cliffs above.
Sapta is a ceremonial elemental brew prepared by shaman trainers. Drinking it changes a seeker's perception and reveals elemental manifestations hidden from ordinary senses.

angles.text: As a young orc or troll shaman, you climb the Hidden Path to Spirit Rock and drink Earth Sapta. There, you begin your bond with the spirits of stone and soil.
